internal_discovery.plain_explanation: hmz never appears as a finite verb; all three tokens are nominal/adjectival. Two of them are intensive agent forms describing a kind of person: humazah (104:1, paired with lumazah under 'woe') and hammaz (68:11, in a vice-list next to namim/talebearing). Both name one who habitually jabs at and disparages other people. The third, hamazat al-shayatin (23:97), is a plural act-noun for the devils' promptings that a person seeks refuge from. Across all three the sense is uniformly hostile and blameworthy; the divergence is that the devils' hamazat target the seeker himself rather than a third party's reputation, which the narrow human sense does not cover.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: hmz is uniformly pejorative/hostile in all 3 tokens (never neutral or approved). It is NOT physical striking/combat (no physical-injury frame attested). It is NOT tale-bearing/namim (in 68:11 hammaz and mashsha' bi-namim are listed as two separate traits, so the jab is distinct from carrying reports). It is held distinct from lamz (104:1 pairs humazah with lumazah as two words, not merged). It does not by itself specify truth/falsity of the speech. It is not restricted to human agency (23:97 attaches it to devils) and not restricted to third-party targets (23:97 targets the self). No finite verb attested, so argument structure is inferred, not directly observed.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence showing hmz applied to a human agent in a clearly non-disparaging, non-honor-attack sense, OR a satanic/hamazat token that is itself directed as defamation at a third party's reputation — either of which would collapse the human-disparagement anchor or the seam between the two classes.

rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not import classical lexical glosses; hold hmz distinct from neighbors lmz (104:1) and namim (68:11) which are separately named; do not let the apotropaic narrative frame of 23:97 be read back as the root's core meaning.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If the human-disparagement anchor is falsified, drop to UNRESOLVED (two unbridged classes); if the seam is falsified toward unity, the thin 'directed hostile prod' nucleus could be re-graded, but strength stays capped at MODERATE at n=3.

reopen_conditions: If a newly confirmed hmz token attaches a human agent to a non-defamation, non-honor-attack act (or a neutral/approved valence), reopen the humazah/hammaz disparagement anchor.
